description: This file defines a wizard for creating advance payment invoices in the Odoo (formerly OpenERP) system, including form definitions, invoice creation logic, and wizard states.

classes.name: sale_advance_payment
classes.description: Wizard class for handling advance payment invoice creation, including invoice creation, viewing, and state management.

methods.name: _createInvoices

methods.name: _open_invoice
methods.description: Opens a window to display created invoices.
